text:
Mira (PM): putting a compact priority grid proposal here for DP recruitment. want clear gates so we don't drift.
Dev (Eng): sounds good. ops can't handle too many high-touch partners.
Samir (ProdOps): ops constraint: 6 active slots, max 2 high-touch. reserve 1 slot for quick follow-ons.
Clara (Research): suggest we score on engagement (35%), expected ROI/strategic value (20%), infra-leverage (15%), feedback depth (20%), compliance risk (10%).
Jo (Design): infra-leverage = partners that exercise vector DBs, streaming, tool-calls, or large-context evals. good tie-breaker.
Mira (PM): also propose an "incentive" tier: small stipend for startups + credits for enterprises. helps commitment.
Dev (Eng): intake must capture p95 latency need, avg prompt length, concurrency, and whether they will run recorded evals.
Clara (Research): scoring formula (0-1 scale): score = 0.35*eng + 0.2*roi + 0.15*infra + 0.2*depth + 0.1*(1-risk)
Samir (ProdOps): operational rules: weekly async updates, demo at mid-loop, survey completion >=70%. I'll encode as acceptance checks.
dp-coordinator-bot: reminder set  will ping 48h before mid-loop and final review. :robot_face:
Jo (Design): success criteria to promote DP -> beta: >=75% participation, no unresolved infra blockers, clear signal improvement on at least one metric (latency, cost, or quality).
Mira (PM): actions: Samir update intake + automations, Clara build scoring sheet, Jo map coverage targets, Dev add infra fields. I'll draft a 1-pager after updates.
Samir (ProdOps): will update now and drop link in #product.
Clara (Research): will share a scoring template with example candidate scores.
Jo (Design): mapping verticals and small-team targets today.
Dev (Eng): adding infra metadata fields now.
Mira (PM): thanks all 9 aiming for shortlist by next Tue. :thumbsup:
